name: claude-skills
description: Claude Code skills by Itamar Dahan: compliance, UI states, spec-driven development and evidence-based READMEs.

plugins.name: acsm
plugins.description: Adaptive Compliance & Security Matrix. Routes a project to the compliance obligations that actually apply to it, audits a repository against them, and drafts the user-facing legal documents they require.

plugins.name: uilint
plugins.description: A linter for the UI states everyone forgets — loading, empty, error, success and partial. 43 rules applied while the interface is written; blocks completion only on the ones that cause silent user harm.

plugins.name: spec-architect
plugins.description: The six-stage spec pipeline for Claude Code. spec-constitution sets the repository's rules, spec-architect writes the spec and its acceptance criteria, spec-tasks turns it into an ordered list, spec-implement executes one task at a time verifying each against the criteria it cites, spec-drift audits whether the code still does what the spec says, and spec-refactor audits whether it can still be changed — proposing structural work that preserves every criterion rather than closing a new one. Refactoring runs are numbered directories under docs/refactorings/ with a permanent smell registry, mirroring how change proposals are versioned under docs/changes/, and spec-drift closes both out — verifying, recording and archiving finished work of either kind. The AC-### identifiers are what join them: assigned once, cited by every later stage.

plugins.name: readme-architect
plugins.description: Writes a repository README from evidence rather than adjectives — runs the project first, then fills a Winnow-shaped skeleton with real output, observed numbers, a mermaid diagram of the mechanism, and an identity block whose every badge states a checkable fact.
